content: {"kind":"plan","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"腿部支撑与髋控制","summary":"居家徒手练腿：髋外展、内收、后链，全程不压手腕","goal":"strength","scene":"home","equipment":["mat","chair"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":20,"avoid":["手腕"],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"scapular-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":8,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":15},{"exerciseId":"glute-max-A","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":8,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":20}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"adductors-A","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":5,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":45},{"exerciseId":"glute-max-A","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":10,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"hamstrings-A","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":8,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"quadriceps-A","mode":"reps","sets":3,"reps":6,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":45},{"exerciseId":"adductors-B","mode":"time","sets":3,"workSeconds":15,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30}]}],"notes":["默认按居家、20 分钟、徒手（垫+椅）安排，未加弹力带。","手腕疼，全部动作避开撑地承重，没有安排手腕/前臂热身和俯撑类动作；库里不压手腕的放松拉伸较少，练完自己滚一滚大腿前后侧。","两周一适应就加组，别急着加难度。"],"safetyNotes":["手腕不适加重或出现刺痛、麻木就立刻停止，必要时找医生或康复师看一下。"]},"text":"今天全走腿：哥萨克蹲开髋、单腿臀桥和后链拉伸力量、北欧练股四离心、哥本哈根收内收。手腕全程不承重，默认居家 20 分钟徒手。"}
